spine.active_goal: After the settings, About and in-app updates build (run home ~/.mitosis/field-notes/settings-about-updates) ships, merges and is released with a tag, publish a closed testing (Alpha) release in Play Console and send the app for Google's first review, so the temporary name 'dev.satanshumishra.field_notes (unreviewed)' becomes "Field Notes" and the app stops being a Draft app. The owner asked for this on 2026-10-11 as the follow-on step to that release.
spine.next_step: The foreground service demo video is recorded (2026-10-12, lab Pixel 9 emulator, profile build of v1.0.0 with lab-only plain-http to a loopback relay behind a 60 KB/s proxy): build/play/field-notes-data-sync-upload.mp4, 77 s, 1080x2424. The owner reviews it, uploads it (for example unlisted on YouTube), pastes the link into App content, Foreground service permissions (Data sync: Network processing, Other), and saves. Then Next and Save on draft release 1.0.0 in Closed testing, Alpha (release notes already saved), and Send for review when the owner chooses. After approval, confirm c1 and delete PLAY_RELEASE_STATUS for c2. Production access needs 12 opted-in testers for 14 days; research on options is pending.
